voice.name: Open Sector - Xenomorph Swarm
voice.note: Shares the Xenomorph Swarm voice designed for the Leech (voices/leech.json); slower and lower for the submarine.
voice.description: A fast, hissing swarm chorus of many small synthetic voices speaking the same words together, like a hive of insect-like machines piloting alien craft: thin and sharp, raspy and buzzing, with dry clicking and a faint wet chitter between words, emotionless and eager, quick clipped cadence, a slightly metallic hollow resonance under the voice.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi plasma torpedo launched from an alien submarine underwater: a deep muffled underwater thump and a rush of bubbles, then a rising electric energy whine as the glowing torpedo speeds away, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Alien biomechanical submarine moving underwater: a deep resonant organic sonar hum pulsing slowly, low muffled throb and soft water rush, a faint eerie sonar ping, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Alien submarine diving: a heavy rush of water and big bubbling gurgles as it submerges, ballast venting with a hiss, water closing over the hull with a deep muffled slosh, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Alien biomechanical submarine destroyed underwater: a muffled deep energy explosion with crackling electric fizz, hull plates groaning and cracking, water rushing in and big bubbles rising as it sinks, no music, no voice
